title: MeetGo
shortDescription: Chat with people from your province, age group and hobbies, and make plans
fullDescription:
MeetGo is the app to talk to people near you who share your hobbies and, when a plan comes up, meet up with them.

HOW IT WORKS
• Pick your hobbies: hiking, padel, cinema, coffee… Each hobby is a chat with people from your province and your age range (18-30, 31-60 and over 60).
• Talk in your chats: reply in threads, mention anyone and react without flooding the conversation.
• Set up the plan in a private group: invite whoever signs up and sort out cars, times and photos without the noise.

COMMUNITIES
• Join communities in your area or create your own, with its entry questions, its age range and its area.
• A plans calendar with attendees, comments and a chat of its own for every meetup.

BIG CHATS THAT STAY READABLE
• Threads with a summary of replies and participants.
• Mentions with their own inbox, and alerts only when someone names you.
• A new-messages divider, reactions, quoted replies and pinned messages.

GROUPS AND DIRECT MESSAGES
• Private groups with invitation links and admin roles.
• Photos, files and voice notes.
• Read receipts to know who has seen it and when.
• Direct messages: with friends you chat right away; with anyone else a request comes first.
• Instant notifications, with quick reply from the notification.

A GOOD ATMOSPHERE
• Automatic moderation: insults, spam and phone numbers posted in public are removed on their own.
• Report a message in two taps; moderators can silence or remove people.
• Slow mode for chats that get too busy, and alerts your way in every conversation.
• Your phone number is never shown.

For people over 18. Available in every province of Spain, and on the web (meetgo.app) with the same account.
